offers_products.reason: Makes transcatheter and surgical heart valves (SAPIEN, RESILIA tissue valves, mitral and tricuspid devices).

offers_services.reason: Sells implantable devices; clinical support and training only accompany the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Hospitals and physicians choose and buy the valves; patients do not pick the device.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells heart valves to hospitals and cardiac surgery institutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Valves are implanted once per patient procedure, though hospitals reorder steadily; revenue is per-procedure device sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Heart valve replacement treats severe cardiovascular disease and is medically necessary, so demand holds in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Each valve is a moderately priced hospital supply item bought frequently, not a major capital purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for patented medical devices, not staff time; it is a device manufacturer.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are hospitals and surgeons; many are mid-sized or independent, and the buyers are not mainly large enterprises or government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Medical device maker; manufacturing needs are moderate and R&D-driven, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Critical Care has moved to BD. Text doesn't say who the buyers are; hospital buyer size is judged from general knowledge.
